card.name: Scattered words in Russia-related web text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered ordinary words (for, time, us, State, Military) in general web prose, often about Russia, the USSR or math.

modes.label: Linking words in essays
modes.description: Short connecting words in phrases such as 'As for now' or 'At the same time'.
modes.example: As<< for>> now, Russia does not have observatories

modes.label: Words in Russia/USSR names
modes.description: Nouns inside institution or state names tied to Russia or the Soviet Union.
